_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-06-28 · Session 81 (StarFarout) · per-row + per-card 📣 nudges landed: every Activity/project card and every RACI matrix row now has its own 📣 to nudge just that item, and the filter-bar bulk button is now '📣 Nudge All'
_status: You can try the new nudge tweaks right now: every Activity and project card carries a 📣 nudge button (next to 📝 Update and 👥 RACI), every row in the RACI matrix has its own 📣 to nudge just that one item, and the bulk button in the filter bar is renamed '📣 Nudge All' (emails everyone who's opted in). Opt-outs are still honored — a member set to no-nudge is never emailed, and a row with no one eligible just says so. Still open: the public Fact Sheet 'consumer wedge' (showing each statewide exhibit's authoritative credit recs under it) is the next big build; the Annual Report doesn't yet self-freshen from the latest item updates the way the cards now do; and three teammate lead emails (Crystal, Terence, Calvin) still need Sam's go-ahead before they can edit (right now only map@rccd.edu can save; everyone can SEE edits).
